units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:4">Keth. IV, 4</cite> <he>חייב … ובפִרְקוֹנָהּ וכ׳</he> is bound to support her, to redeem her (when she is captured), and to bury her.

<cite ref="Ketubot 47b:4-5">Ib. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>תיקנו … ופִירְקוֹנָהּ תחת וכ׳</he> they instituted the duty of support as an equivalent for her handiwork, and that of redemption as an equivalent for the privilege of usufruct (of her property).
Y. Maas. Sh. IV, 55ᵇ [read:] פ״י פרקון the mark Pé on a vessel means peraḳon (redemption, i.e. second tithes).
